## Keep keyboard visible when vertically zooming the mapping zone

The mapping zone in the Shortcircuit XT UI currently hides the keyboard when you zoom vertically. The `MappingZonesAndKeyboard` component contains both the zone mapping area and the piano keyboard, and when the `Zoomable` viewport resizes its viewed component, the keyboard scrolls out of view.

    Your task is to restructure the mapping pane so the keyboard remains visible at all times, even when the vertical zoom level changes. The zones area should be independently zoomable while the keyboard stays fixed at the bottom.

    Specifically, you need to:
    1. Split `MappingZonesAndKeyboard` into two separate components: one for the zones display (which will be zoomed) and one for the keyboard (which will stay fixed).
    2. Move keyboard-only state and mouse handling into the new `Keyboard` component.
    3. Make the `MappingDisplay` a `juce::ComponentListener` so it can forward zoom and scroll events to both viewports (zones and keyboard).
    4. Guard against recursive `componentMovedOrResized` callbacks when the viewport resizes its viewed component.
    5. Force the visibility of scrollbars in the `Zoomable` viewport to prevent the viewed component from being resized when scrollbars are hidden.

## Environment Setup
Check `CMakeLists.txt` in the repository root and in `src-ui/CMakeLists.txt` for build configuration. Look at `README.md` for any build instructions. The file to modify is `src-ui/components/multi/MappingPane.cpp`.

## Implementation Plan
1. Split `MappingZonesAndKeyboard` into `Keyboard` and `MappingZones` structs. Move the piano rendering, MIDI note handling (mouseDown/Up/Drag for heldNote), and the `rectangleForKey` helper into `Keyboard`. Keep zone painting, zone rectangle calculations, and zone mouse interactions in `MappingZones`.
    2. Update `MappingDisplay` to hold both components as members, each wrapped in its own `Zoomable` viewport. Set up the keyboard viewport to only zoom horizontally, and the zones viewport to zoom both horizontally and vertically.
    3. Make `MappingDisplay` inherit from `juce::ComponentListener`. In `componentMovedOrResized`, synchronize the horizontal scroll position between the two viewports and forward zoom changes between them as needed.
    4. Add a guard flag (e.g. `bool isUpdatingComponents`) to prevent infinite recursion when the viewport resizing triggers the listener again.
    5. In the `Zoomable` constructor, call `setAutoHide(false)` on both scrollbars so they always occupy space and never cause the viewed component to be resized.

150: struct Zoomable : public juce::Component
151: {
152: 
153:     std::unique_ptr<juce::Viewport> viewport;
154:     int scrollDirection = 1;
155:     void invertScroll(bool invert) { scrollDirection = invert ? -1 : 1; }
156: 
157:     struct zoomFactor
158:     {
159:         float acc = 1.f;
160:         int val = 1;
161:         float min = 1.f;
162:         float max = 4.f;
163:     } zoomX, zoomY;
164: 
165:     enum class Axis
166:     {
167:         horizontalZoom,
168:         verticalZoom
169:     };
170: 
171:     Zoomable(juce::Component *attachedComponent,
172:              std::pair<float, float> minMaxX = std::make_pair(1.f, 4.f),
173:              std::pair<float, float> minMaxY = std::make_pair(1.f, 4.f))
174:         : zoomX({1.f, 1, minMaxX.first, minMaxX.second}),
175:           zoomY({1.f, 1, minMaxY.first, minMaxY.second})
176:     {
177:         viewport = std::make_unique<juce::Viewport>();
178:         viewport->setViewedComponent(attachedComponent, false);
179:         addAndMakeVisible(*viewport);
180:     }
181: 
182:     void resized() override
183:     {
184:         auto viewArea = getLocalBounds();
185:         viewport->setBounds(0, 0, getWidth(), getHeight());
186:         auto zoneArea =
187:             viewArea.withWidth(viewArea.getWidth() * zoomX.val - viewport->getScrollBarThickness())
188:                 .withHeight(viewArea.getHeight() * zoomY.val - viewport->getScrollBarThickness());
189:         viewport->getViewedComponent()->setBounds(zoneArea);
190:     }
191: 
192:     void zoom(Axis axis, float delta, const juce::Point<float> &p)
193:     {
194:         constexpr auto acceleration = 10.f;
195: 
196:         auto &z = axis == Axis::horizontalZoom ? zoomX : zoomY;
197:         z.acc += delta * acceleration * scrollDirection;
198:         auto m = 0.f;
199:         std::modf(z.acc, &m);
200:         auto zoom = m != 0.f;
201:         if (zoom)
202:         {
203:             auto prevVal = static_cast<float>(z.val);
204:             z.val = std::clamp(z.val + m, z.min, z.max);
205:             z.acc = 0.f;
206: 
207:             auto viewedComp = viewport->getViewedComponent();
208: 
209:             auto x = viewedComp->getX();
210:             auto y = viewedComp->getY();
211: 
212:             auto w = viewport->getWidth() * zoomX.val - viewport->getScrollBarThickness();
213:             auto h = viewport->getHeight() * zoomY.val - viewport->getScrollBarThickness();
214: 
215:             auto applyZoom = [prevVal, z](auto &compPos, auto compSize, auto viewSize,
216:                                           auto mousePos) {
217:                 auto hvs = viewSize / 2;
218:                 auto offset = hvs - mousePos;
219:                 compPos += offset;
220:                 offset = hvs - compPos;
221:                 compPos -= offset * (z.val / prevVal - 1);
222:                 compPos = std::clamp(compPos, -compSize + viewSize, 0);
223:             };
224:             if (axis == Axis::horizontalZoom)
225:             {
226:                 applyZoom(x, w, viewport->getWidth(), p.x);
227:             }
228:             else
229:             {
230:                 applyZoom(y, h, viewport->getHeight(), p.y);
231:             }
232: 
233:             viewedComp->setBounds(x, y, w, h);
234:         }
235:     }
236: 
237:     void mouseWheelMove(const juce::MouseEvent &e, const juce::MouseWheelDetails &w) override
238:     {
239:         if (e.mods.isAltDown())
240:         {
241:             auto axis = e.mods.isShiftDown() ? Axis::horizontalZoom : Axis::verticalZoom;
242:             zoom(axis, w.deltaY, e.position);
243:         }
244:     }
245: };

601: void MappingZonesAndKeyboard::mouseDown(const juce::MouseEvent &e)
602: {
603:     if (!display)
604:         return;
605:     mouseState = NONE;
606:     if (e.position.y > keyboardHeight)
607:     {
608:         for (int i = firstMidiNote; i < lastMidiNote; ++i)
609:         {
610:             auto r = rectangleForKey(i);
611:             if (r.contains(e.position))
612:             {
613:                 sendToSerialization(cmsg::NoteFromGUI({i, true}));
614:                 heldNote = i;
615:                 if (heldNote == display->mappingView.rootKey)
616:                 {
617:                     mouseState = HELD_ROOT_NOTE;
618:                 }
619:                 else
620:                 {
621:                     mouseState = HELD_NOTE;
622:                 }
623:                 repaint();
624:                 return;
625:             }
626:         }
627:     }
628: 
629:     // const auto &sel = display->editor->currentSingleSelection;
630: 
631:     for (const auto &ks : keyboardHotZones)
632:     {
633:         if (ks.contains(e.position))
634:         {
635:             mouseState = DRAG_KEY;
636:             return;
637:         }
638:     }
639: 
640:     for (const auto &ks : velocityHotZones)
641:     {
642:         if (ks.contains(e.position))
643:         {
644:             mouseState = DRAG_VELOCITY;
645:             return;
646:         }
647:     }
648: 
649:     for (const auto &ks : bothHotZones)
650:     {
651:         if (ks.contains(e.position))
652:         {
653:             mouseState = DRAG_KEY_AND_VEL;
654:             return;
655:         }
656:     }
657: 
658:     for (const auto &ks : lastSelectedZone)
659:     {
660:         if (ks.contains(e.position))
661:         {
662:             lastMousePos = e.position;
663:             mouseState = DRAG_SELECTED_ZONE;
664:             return;
665:         }
666:     }
667: 
668:     std::vector<selection::SelectionManager::ZoneAddress> potentialZones;
669:     for (auto &z : display->summary)
670:     {
671:         auto r = rectangleForZone(z.second);
672:         if (r.contains(e.position) && display->editor->isAnyZoneFromGroupSelected(z.first.group))
673:             potentialZones.push_back(z.first);
674:     }
675:     selection::SelectionManager::ZoneAddress nextZone;
676:     if (!potentialZones.empty())
677:     {
678:         if (potentialZones.size() == 1)
679:         {
680:             nextZone = potentialZones[0];
681:         }
682:         else
683:         {
684:             // OK so now we have a stack. Basically what we want to
685:             // do is choose the 'next' one after our currently
686:             // selected as a heuristic
687:             auto cz = -1;
688:             if (display->editor->currentLeadZoneSelection.has_value())
689:                 cz = display->editor->currentLeadZoneSelection->zone;
690: 
691:             auto selThis = -1;
692:             for (const auto &[idx, za] : sst::cpputils::enumerate(potentialZones))
693:             {
694:                 if (za.zone > cz && selThis < 0)
695:                     selThis = idx;
696:             }
697: 
698:             if (selThis < 0 || selThis >= potentialZones.size())
699:                 nextZone = potentialZones.front();
700:             else
701:                 nextZone = potentialZones[selThis];
702:         }
703: 
704:         if (display->editor->isSelected(nextZone))
705:         {
706:             if (e.mods.isCommandDown())
707:             {
708:                 // command click a selected zone deselects it
709:                 display->editor->doSelectionAction(nextZone, false, false, false);
710:             }
711:             else if (e.mods.isAltDown())
712:             {
713:                 // alt click promotes it to lead
714:                 display->editor->doSelectionAction(nextZone, true, false, true);
715:             }
716:             else
717:             {
718:                 // single click makes it a single lead
719:                 display->editor->doSelectionAction(nextZone, true, true, true);
720:             }
721:         }
722:         else
723:         {
724:             display->editor->doSelectionAction(
725:                 nextZone, true, !(e.mods.isCommandDown() || e.mods.isAltDown()), true);
726:         }
727:     }
728: }

730: void MappingZonesAndKeyboard::mouseDrag(const juce::MouseEvent &e)
731: {
732:     if (mouseState == DRAG_SELECTED_ZONE)
733:     {
734:         auto lb = getLocalBounds().toFloat();
735:         auto displayRegion = lb.withTrimmedBottom(keyboardHeight);
736: 
737:         auto kw = displayRegion.getWidth() / (lastMidiNote - firstMidiNote + 1);
738:         auto vh = displayRegion.getHeight() / 127.0;
739: 
740:         auto dx = e.position.x - lastMousePos.x;
741:         auto &kr = display->mappingView.keyboardRange;
742:         auto nx = (int)(dx / kw) + firstMidiNote;
743: 
744:         if (kr.keyStart + nx < 0)
745:             nx = -kr.keyStart;
746:         else if (kr.keyEnd + nx > 127)
747:             nx = 127 - kr.keyEnd;
748:         if (nx != 0)
749:         {
750:             lastMousePos.x = e.position.x;
751:             kr.keyStart += nx;
752:             kr.keyEnd += nx;
753: 
754:             display->mappingView.rootKey = std::clamp(display->mappingView.rootKey + nx, 0, 127);
755:         }
756: 
757:         auto dy = -(e.position.y - lastMousePos.y);
758:         auto &vr = display->mappingView.velocityRange;
759:         auto vy = (int)(dy / vh);
760: 
761:         if (vr.velStart + vy < 0)
762:             vy = -vr.velStart;
763:         else if (vr.velEnd + vy > 127)
764:             vy = 127 - vr.velEnd;
765:         if (vy != 0)
766:         {
767:             lastMousePos.y = e.position.y;
768:             vr.velStart += vy;
769:             vr.velEnd += vy;
770:         }
771: 
772:         display->mappingChangedFromGUI();
773:         repaint();
774:     }
775: 
776:     if (mouseState == DRAG_VELOCITY || mouseState == DRAG_KEY || mouseState == DRAG_KEY_AND_VEL)
777:     {
778:         auto lb = getLocalBounds().toFloat();
779:         auto displayRegion = lb.withTrimmedBottom(keyboardHeight);
780:         auto kw = displayRegion.getWidth() / (lastMidiNote - firstMidiNote + 1);
781:         auto vh = displayRegion.getHeight() / 127.0;
782: 
783:         auto nx = std::clamp((int)std::round(e.position.x / kw) + firstMidiNote, 0, 127);
784:         auto vy = std::clamp(127 - (int)std::round(e.position.y / vh), 0, 127);
785: 
786:         auto &vr = display->mappingView.velocityRange;
787:         auto &kr = display->mappingView.keyboardRange;
788: 
789:         if (mouseState == DRAG_KEY_AND_VEL || mouseState == DRAG_KEY)
790:         {
791:             auto drs = abs(kr.keyStart - nx);
792:             auto dre = abs(kr.keyEnd - nx);
793:             if (drs < dre)
794:                 kr.keyStart = nx;
795:             else
796:                 kr.keyEnd = nx;
797:             if (kr.keyStart > kr.keyEnd)
798:                 std::swap(kr.keyStart, kr.keyEnd);
799:         }
800: 
801:         if (mouseState == DRAG_KEY_AND_VEL || mouseState == DRAG_VELOCITY)
802:         {
803:             auto vrs = abs(vr.velStart - vy);
804:             auto vre = abs(vr.velEnd - vy);
805:             if (vrs < vre)
806:                 vr.velStart = vy;
807:             else
808:                 vr.velEnd = vy;
809:             if (vr.velStart > vr.velEnd)
810:                 std::swap(vr.velStart, vr.velEnd);
811:         }
812:         display->mappingChangedFromGUI();
813:         repaint();
814:     }
815: 
816:     if (mouseState == HELD_NOTE || mouseState == HELD_ROOT_NOTE)
817:     {
818:         if (e.position.y > keyboardHeight)
819:         {
820:             for (int i = firstMidiNote; i < lastMidiNote; ++i)
821:             {
822:                 auto r = rectangleForKey(i);
823:                 if (r.contains(e.position))
824:                 {
825:                     if (i == heldNote)
826:                     {
827:                         // that's OK!
828:                     }
829:                     else
830:                     {
831:                         if (heldNote > 0)
832:                         {
833:                             sendToSerialization(cmsg::NoteFromGUI({heldNote, false}));
834:                         }
835:                         if (mouseState == HELD_ROOT_NOTE)
836:                         {
837:                             display->mappingView.rootKey = i;
838:                             display->mappingChangedFromGUI();
839:                         }
840:                         heldNote = i;
841:                         sendToSerialization(cmsg::NoteFromGUI({i, true}));
842:                         repaint();
843:                     }
844:                 }
845:             }
846:         }
847:     }
848: }

870: juce::Rectangle<float> MappingZonesAndKeyboard::rectangleForRange(int kL, int kH, int vL, int vH)
871: {
872:     auto lb = getLocalBounds().toFloat();
873:     auto displayRegion = lb.withTrimmedBottom(keyboardHeight);
874:     auto kw = displayRegion.getWidth() / (lastMidiNote - firstMidiNote);
875:     auto vh = displayRegion.getHeight() / 127.0;
876: 
877:     float x0 = (kL - firstMidiNote) * kw;
878:     float x1 = (kH - firstMidiNote + 1) * kw;
879:     if (x1 < x0)
880:         std::swap(x1, x0);
881:     float y0 = (127 - vL) * vh;
882:     float y1 = (127 - vH) * vh;
883:     if (y1 < y0)
884:         std::swap(y1, y0);
885: 
886:     return {x0, y0, x1 - x0, y1 - y0};
887: }

889: juce::Rectangle<float> MappingZonesAndKeyboard::rectangleForKey(int midiNote)
890: {
891:     assert(lastMidiNote > firstMidiNote);
892:     auto lb = getLocalBounds().toFloat();
893:     auto keyRegion = lb.withTop(lb.getBottom() - keyboardHeight + 1);
894:     auto kw = keyRegion.getWidth() / (lastMidiNote - firstMidiNote);
895: 
896:     keyRegion = keyRegion.withWidth(kw).translated(kw * (midiNote - firstMidiNote), 0);
897: 
898:     return keyRegion;
899: }

901: void MappingZonesAndKeyboard::paint(juce::Graphics &g)
902: {
903:     if (!display)
904:         g.fillAll(juce::Colours::red);
905: 
906:     // Draw the background
907:     {
908:         auto lb = getLocalBounds().toFloat();
909:         auto displayRegion = lb.withTrimmedBottom(keyboardHeight);
910: 
911:         auto dashCol = juce::Colour(80, 80, 80);
912:         g.setColour(dashCol);
913:         g.drawRect(displayRegion, 1.f);
914: 
915:         dashCol = juce::Colour(50, 50, 60);
916:         g.setColour(dashCol);
917: 
918:         auto dh = displayRegion.getHeight() / 4.0;
919:         for (int i = 1; i < 4; ++i)
920:         {
921:             g.drawHorizontalLine(i * dh, lb.getX(), lb.getX() + lb.getWidth());
922:         }
923: 
924:         auto oct = displayRegion.getWidth() / 127.0 * 12.0;
925:         for (int i = 0; i < 127; i += 12)
926:         {
927:             auto o = i / 12;
928:             g.drawVerticalLine(o * oct, lb.getY(), lb.getY() + lb.getHeight());
929:         }
930:     }
931: 
932:     auto drawVoiceMarkers = [&g](const juce::Rectangle<float> &c, int ct) {
933:         if (ct == 0)
934:             return;
935:         auto r = c.reduced(2).withTrimmedTop(25);
936: 
937:         int vrad{8};
938:         if (r.getWidth() < vrad)
939:         {
940:             vrad = r.getWidth();
941:             auto b = r.withTop(r.getBottom() - vrad).withWidth(vrad);
942:             g.setColour(juce::Colours::orange);
943:             g.fillRoundedRectangle(b.toFloat(), 1);
944:             return;
945:         }
946:         auto b = r.withTop(r.getBottom() - vrad).withWidth(vrad);
947:         g.setColour(juce::Colours::orange);
948:         for (int i = 0; i < ct; ++i)
949:         {
950:             g.fillRoundedRectangle(b.reduced(1).toFloat(), 1);
951:             b = b.translated(vrad, 0);
952:             if (!r.contains(b))
953:             {
954:                 b.setX(r.getX());
955:                 b = b.translated(0, -vrad);
956: 
957:                 if (!r.contains(b))
958:                     return;
959:             }
960:         }
961:     };
962: 
963:     for (const auto &drawSelected : {false, true})
964:     {
965:         for (const auto &z : display->summary)
966:         {
967:             if (!display->editor->isAnyZoneFromGroupSelected(z.first.group))
968:                 continue;
969: 
970:             if (display->editor->isSelected(z.first) != drawSelected)
971:                 continue;
972: 
973:             if (z.first == display->editor->currentLeadZoneSelection)
974:                 continue;
975: 
976:             auto r = rectangleForZone(z.second);
977: 
978:             auto nonSelZoneColor = juce::Colour(140, 140, 140);
979:             if (drawSelected)
980:                 nonSelZoneColor = juce::Colour(0xFF, 0x90, 0x00);
981:             g.setColour(nonSelZoneColor.withAlpha(0.2f));
982:             g.fillRect(r);
983:             g.setColour(nonSelZoneColor);
984:             g.drawRect(r, 2.f);
985:             g.setColour(nonSelZoneColor.brighter());
986:             g.setFont(connectors::SCXTStyleSheetCreator::interMediumFor(12));
987:             g.drawText(std::get<2>(z.second), r.reduced(5, 3), juce::Justification::topLeft);
988: 
989:             auto ct = display->voiceCountFor(z.first);
990:             drawVoiceMarkers(r, ct);
991:         }
992:     }
993: 
994:     auto selZoneColor = juce::Colour(0x00, 0x90, 0xFF);
995:     if (display->editor->currentLeadZoneSelection.has_value())
996:     {
997:         const auto &sel = *(display->editor->currentLeadZoneSelection);
998: 
999:         for (const auto &z : display->summary)
1000:         {
1001:             if (!(z.first == sel))
1002:                 continue;
1003: 
1004:             auto r = rectangleForZone(z.second);
1005: 
1006:             g.setColour(selZoneColor.withAlpha(0.2f));
1007:             g.fillRect(r);
1008: 
1009:             const float dashes[]{1.0f, 2.0f};
1010: 
1011:             g.setColour(selZoneColor.withAlpha(0.8f));
1012:             g.drawDashedLine({{r.getX() + 1, 0}, {r.getX() + 1, r.getY()}}, dashes,
1013:                              juce::numElementsInArray(dashes));
1014:             g.drawDashedLine({{r.getX() + 1, r.getBottom()}, {r.getX() + 1, (float)getHeight()}},
1015:                              dashes, juce::numElementsInArray(dashes));
1016:             g.drawDashedLine({{r.getRight() - 1, 0}, {r.getRight() - 1, r.getY()}}, dashes,
1017:                              juce::numElementsInArray(dashes));
1018:             g.drawDashedLine(
1019:                 {{r.getRight() - 1, r.getBottom()}, {r.getRight() - 1, (float)getHeight()}}, dashes,
1020:                 juce::numElementsInArray(dashes));
1021: 
1022:             g.setColour(selZoneColor);
1023:             g.drawRect(r, 2.f);
1024: 
1025:             g.setColour(juce::Colours::white);
1026:             g.setFont(connectors::SCXTStyleSheetCreator::interMediumFor(12));
1027:             g.drawText(std::get<2>(z.second), r.reduced(5, 3), juce::Justification::topLeft);
1028: 
1029:             auto ct = display->voiceCountFor(z.first);
1030:             drawVoiceMarkers(r, ct);
1031:         }
1032:     }
1033: 
1034:     std::array<int, 128> midiState; // 0 == 0ff, 1 == gated, 2 == sounding
1035:     std::fill(midiState.begin(), midiState.end(), 0);
1036:     for (const auto &vd : display->editor->sharedUiMemoryState.voiceDisplayItems)
1037:     {
1038:         if (vd.active && vd.midiNote >= 0)
1039:         {
1040:             midiState[vd.midiNote] = vd.gated ? 1 : 2;
1041:         }
1042:     }
1043:     for (int i = firstMidiNote; i < lastMidiNote; ++i)
1044:     {
1045:         auto n = i % 12;
1046:         auto isBlackKey = (n == 1 || n == 3 || n == 6 || n == 8 || n == 10);
1047:         auto kr = rectangleForKey(i);
1048:         g.setColour(isBlackKey ? juce::Colours::black : juce::Colours::white);
1049:         g.fillRect(kr);
1050:         if (midiState[i] != 0)
1051:         {
1052:             g.setColour(midiState[i] == 1 ? juce::Colours::orange
1053:                                           : (isBlackKey ? juce::Colour(0x80, 0x80, 0x90)
1054:                                                         : juce::Colour(0xC0, 0xC0, 0xD0)));
1055:             if (i == heldNote)
1056:                 g.setColour(juce::Colours::red);
1057: 
1058:             g.fillRect(kr);
1059:         }
1060: 
1061:         if (i == display->mappingView.rootKey)
1062:         {
1063:             g.setColour(selZoneColor);
1064:             g.fillRect(kr);
1065:         }
1066: 
1067:         g.setColour(juce::Colour(140, 140, 140));
1068:         g.drawRect(kr, 0.5);
1069:     }
1070: 
1071:     constexpr auto lastOctave = 11;
1072:     for (int octave = 0; octave < lastOctave; ++octave)
1073:     {
1074:         assert(octave <= 10);
1075:         auto r = rectangleForKey(octave * 12);
1076:         r.setLeft(r.getX() + 1);
1077:         r.setWidth(r.getWidth() * 12);
1078:         g.setColour(juce::Colours::black);
1079:         // defaultMidiNoteOctaveOffset = -1 => first octave is C-2
1080:         auto offset = -1 + sst::basic_blocks::params::ParamMetaData::defaultMidiNoteOctaveOffset;
1081:         g.drawText(fmt::format("C{}", octave + offset), r, juce::Justification::bottomLeft);
1082:     }
1083: 
1084:     if (display->isUndertakingDrop)
1085:     {
1086:         auto rr = rootAndRangeForPosition(display->currentDragPoint);
1087:         auto rb = rectangleForRange(rr[1], rr[2], 0, 127);
1088:         g.setColour(juce::Colour(0xFF, 0x90, 0x00).withAlpha(0.4f));
1089:         g.fillRect(rb);
1090:     }
1091: }

1093: std::array<int16_t, 3> MappingZonesAndKeyboard::rootAndRangeForPosition(const juce::Point<int> &p)
1094: {
1095:     assert(lastMidiNote > firstMidiNote);
1096:     auto lb = getLocalBounds().toFloat();
1097:     auto keyRegion = lb.withTop(lb.getBottom() - keyboardHeight + 1);
1098:     auto kw = keyRegion.getWidth() / (lastMidiNote - firstMidiNote);
1099: 
1100:     auto rootKey =
1101:         std::clamp(p.getX() * 1.f / kw + firstMidiNote, (float)firstMidiNote, (float)lastMidiNote);
1102: 
1103:     auto fromTop = std::clamp(p.getY(), 0, getHeight()) * 1.f / getHeight();
1104:     auto span = (1.0f - fromTop) * 80 + 1;
1105:     auto low = std::clamp(rootKey - span, 0.f, 127.f);
1106:     auto high = std::clamp(rootKey + span, 0.f, 127.f);
1107:     return {(int16_t)rootKey, (int16_t)low, (int16_t)high};
1108: }

# Shortcircuit XT

[![CI Build Status](https://dev.azure.com/surge-synthesizer/surge/_apis/build/status/surge-synthesizer.shortcircuit-xt?branchName=main)](https://dev.azure.com/surge-synthesizer/shortcircuit-xt/_build/latest?definitionId=2&branchName=main)

Welcome to Shortcircuit XT.

Shortcircuit was a popular creative sampler in the mid 2000s from vembertech, the
company that originally created surge. In 2021, Claes Johansen, the principle
at vembertech (and now at Bitwig), open sourced a version of Shortcircuit2
and gave the source to the Surge Synth Team.

After several false starts getting this code running, we made a decision in
early 2023 to preserve much of the design and DSP code from SC2, but to
rebuild a sampler in the spirit of the first two versions of Shortcircuit using
modern C++ and JUCE. This project, which you are looking at here, is called
Shortcircuit XT (SCXT) and is underway.

Right now, you can download our pre-alpha version of the
instrument [here](https://github.com/surge-synthesizer/shortcircuit-xt/releases/tag/Nightly)
or you can build it using the instructions below.

## What Works, and How Can I Help?

Well first, thanks for asking! As we proceed through summer 2023, more and more
stuff is starting to work, but we have a lot to do to get to a working beta.
We have a rather complete wireframe of the final product, though, and have made
quite a few core decisions about selection, mechanics, playback, and more, some of which
are reflected in the code.

If you are going to use the product now, though, many things will be incomplete or
mysteriously not work. Really the best way to particpate is to join the [surge synth team
discord](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/surge-synthesizer/surge-synthesizer.github.io/master/_includes/discord_invite_link)
and come say hi in the #sc-development channel.

There's lots of ways you can help. Of course, developers are always welcome. But testers,
design partners, and just generally nice people who want to shoot-the-you-know-what about
a sample-initiated instrument can join in the fun. Also, folks who loved and used SC1 and 2
are welcome to come and see what we are thinking is different and the same, and help us
determine if we are right!

## I would love to build it myself. What do I do?

To build, first configure your machine. Basically set up your machien the same way you would
[to build Surge XT](https://github.com/surge-synthesizer/surge#setting-up-for-your-os) then
fork this repo and:

```bash
git clone <this repo or your fork>
cd shortcircuit-xt
git submodule update --init --recursive
cmake -Bignore/build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
cmake --build ignore/build --config Release --target scxt_plugin_All
```

Our production build use clang and macos, and gcc on linux. We
we test with a wide variety of compilers, including msvc on windows and several gcc versions.
If you are using a new compiler and have changes to the CMake or so on, please
do send them to us.

## How we got here?

Vember Audio, founded by [@kurasu](https://github.com/kurasu)/Claes Johanson, released Surge and Shortcircuit in the
2000s. In 2018, Claes, realizing he would not complete Surge 1.6, open sourced it. A community arose around it, leading
to Surge we have today.

In late 2020, [@baconpaul](https://github.com/baconpaul) (one of the maintainers of Surge) sent a thank you note to
Claes for open sourcing Surge and they got to chatting about Shortcircuit. That led to Claes sending Paul the source
code, and that led to this repository and plan. We had a couple of false starts, but are
confident in the path and architecture we have now!

# An important note about licensing

Just like with Surge, we welcome any and all contributions from anyone who wants to work on open source music software.

At the initial open-sourcing, the copyright to the Shortcircuit source was held by Claes (on the initial code) and
Paul (on his diffs since Claes shared the code). This repository is licensed under GPL3. We know that, if we end up with
Shortcircuit XT, we will end up with a GPL3 plugin, since it will depend on JUCE or VST3SDK, which are GPL3 if used in
an open source context.

# CMakeList.txt to build Shortcircuit XT
#
# Shortcircuit XT began with a not-building snap of the code which was used
# at some point in the SC2 product cycle, so we took a different strategy which was:
#
# 1. Have a libshortcircuit-core basically which contains all the code to be SC
# 2. Expose that in an shortcircuit-headless, shortcircuitpy library and exe
# 3. Rebuild the plugin using that library and JUCE
#
# At least that's the plan. Critically this no longer builds any of the old GUI or
# VST2 code, which we couldn't make work anyway. That code is still in the codebase for
# reference as we port, but we should remove it before we ship Shortcircuit XT
#

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0091 NEW)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0063 NEW)
set(CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreaded$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:Debug>")
# https://github.com/taocpp/PEGTL/issues/347 would let us go to 13
set(CMAKE_OSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET 10.14 CACHE STRING "Minimum macOS version")
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)

# TODO Remove This before we ship non beta version. Remember
# the AU rescans only when versions change even if binaries are
# different.
message(STATUS "Using date-driven version while in alpha")
string(TIMESTAMP DAY_OF_YEAR "%j")
string(TIMESTAMP YEAR "%Y")
math(EXPR PART0 "${YEAR}-2023 + 6")
math(EXPR PART1 "${DAY_OF_YEAR} + 1")

project(ShortcircuitXT VERSION 0.${PART0}.${PART1}.0 LANGUAGES C CXX ASM)
set(ShortcircuitXT_VERSION ${PROJECT_VERSION})

option(SCXT_JUCE_CLASSIC_STYLE "Use juse classic vs clap-first style" ON)

if (APPLE)
    enable_language(OBJC)
    enable_language(OBJCXX)
    set(CMAKE_OBJC_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden)
    set(CMAKE_OBJCXX_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden)

        add_link_options(-Wl,-ld_classic)
        add_compile_definitions(JUCE_SILENCE_XCODE_15_LINKER_WARNING=1)
    endif()
endif ()

set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF CACHE BOOL "Never want shared if not specified")
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

**1. Split `MappingZonesAndKeyboard` into two components:**
- `Keyboard` — owns the piano rendering (keys, MIDI state, root-key highlight, octave labels), `rectangleForKey`, `heldNote`, and note mouse handling (`mouseDown`/`mouseDrag`/`mouseUp` for `HELD_NOTE`/`HELD_ROOT_NOTE`), plus `keyboardHeight`.

**2. `MappingDisplay` holds both, each in its own `Zoomable`:**
- `zonesViewport` zooms both axes; `keyboardViewport` is locked to horizontal zoom only via `minMaxY = (1.f, 1.f)`.

1557: void SampleWaveform::rebuildHotZones()
1558: {
1559:     static constexpr int hotZoneSize{10};
1560:     auto &v = display->sampleView[0];
1561:     auto samp = editor->sampleManager.getSample(v.sampleID);
1562:     if (!samp)
1563:     {
1564:         return;
1565:     }
1566:     auto r = getLocalBounds();
1567:     auto l = samp->getSampleLength();
1568:     auto fac = 1.0 * r.getWidth() / l;
1569:     auto start = v.startSample * fac;
1570:     auto end = v.endSample * fac;
1571:     auto ls = v.startLoop * fac;
1572:     auto le = v.endLoop * fac;
1573: 
1574:     startSampleHZ = juce::Rectangle<int>(start + r.getX(), r.getBottom() - hotZoneSize, hotZoneSize,
1575:                                          hotZoneSize);
1576:     endSampleHZ = juce::Rectangle<int>(end + r.getX() - hotZoneSize, r.getBottom() - hotZoneSize,
1577:                                        hotZoneSize, hotZoneSize);
1578:     startLoopHZ = juce::Rectangle<int>(ls + r.getX(), r.getY(), hotZoneSize, hotZoneSize);
1579:     endLoopHZ =
1580:         juce::Rectangle<int>(le + r.getX() - hotZoneSize, r.getY(), hotZoneSize, hotZoneSize);
1581: }

1609: juce::Path SampleWaveform::pathForSample()
1610: {
1611:     juce::Path res;
1612: 
1613:     auto r = getLocalBounds();
1614:     auto &v = display->sampleView[0];
1615:     auto samp = editor->sampleManager.getSample(v.sampleID);
1616:     if (!samp)
1617:     {
1618:         SCLOG("Null Sample: Null Path");
1619:         return res;
1620:     }
1621: 
1622:     auto l = samp->getSampleLength();
1623:     std::vector<float> topLine, bottomLine;
1624: 
1625:     if (samp->bitDepth == sample::Sample::BD_I16)
1626:     {
1627:         auto fac = 1.0 * l / r.getWidth();
1628:         auto d = samp->GetSamplePtrI16(0);
1629:         double c = 0;
1630:         int ct = 0;
1631:         int16_t mx = std::numeric_limits<int16_t>::min();
1632:         int16_t mn = std::numeric_limits<int16_t>::max();
1633: 
1634:         for (int s = 0; s < l; ++s)
1635:         {
1636:             if (c + fac < s)
1637:             {
1638:                 double nmx = 1.0 - mx * 1.0 / std::numeric_limits<int16_t>::max();
1639:                 double nmn = 1.0 - mn * 1.0 / std::numeric_limits<int16_t>::max();
1640: 
1641:                 nmx = (nmx + 1) * 0.25;
1642:                 nmn = (nmn + 1) * 0.25;
1643: 
1644:                 topLine.push_back(nmx);
1645:                 bottomLine.push_back(nmn);
1646: 
1647:                 c += fac;
1648:                 ct++;
1649:                 mx = std::numeric_limits<int16_t>::min();
1650:                 mn = std::numeric_limits<int16_t>::max();
1651:             }
1652:             mx = std::max(d[s], mx);
1653:             mn = std::min(d[s], mn);
1654:         }
1655:     }
1656:     else if (samp->bitDepth == sample::Sample::BD_F32)
1657:     {
1658:         auto fac = 1.0 * l / r.getWidth();
1659:         auto d = samp->GetSamplePtrF32(0);
1660:         double c = 0;
1661:         int ct = 0;
1662: 
1663:         float mx = -100.f, mn = 100.f;
1664: 
1665:         for (int s = 0; s < l; ++s)
1666:         {
1667:             if (c + fac < s)
1668:             {
1669:                 double nmx = 1.0 - mx;
1670:                 double nmn = 1.0 - mn;
1671: 
1672:                 nmx = (nmx + 1) * 0.25;
1673:                 nmn = (nmn + 1) * 0.25;
1674: 
1675:                 topLine.push_back(nmx);
1676:                 bottomLine.push_back(nmn);
1677:                 c += fac;
1678:                 ct++;
1679:                 mx = -100.f;
1680:                 mn = 100.f;
1681:             }
1682:             mx = std::max(d[s], mx);
1683:             mn = std::min(d[s], mn);
1684:         }
1685:     }
1686:     else
1687:     {
1688:         jassertfalse;
1689:     }
1690: 
1691:     std::reverse(bottomLine.begin(), bottomLine.end());
1692:     int index{0};
1693:     for (auto &l : topLine)
1694:     {
1695:         if (index == 0)
1696:         {
1697:             res.startNewSubPath(index, l * r.getHeight());
1698:         }
1699:         else
1700:         {
1701:             res.lineTo(index, l * r.getHeight());
1702:         }
1703:         index++;
1704:     }
1705: 
1706:     index--;
1707:     for (auto &l : bottomLine)
1708:     {
1709:         res.lineTo(index, l * r.getHeight());
1710:         index--;
1711:     }
1712:     res.closeSubPath();
1713: 
1714:     return res;
1715: }

1736: {

1741:     {
1742:     case MouseState::HZ_DRAG_SAMPSTART:
1743:         display->sampleView[0].startSample = sampleForXPixel(e.position.x);
1744:         break;
1745:     case MouseState::HZ_DRAG_SAMPEND:
1746:         display->sampleView[0].endSample = sampleForXPixel(e.position.x);
1747:         break;
1748:     case MouseState::HZ_DRAG_LOOPSTART:
1749:         display->sampleView[0].startLoop = sampleForXPixel(e.position.x);
1750:         break;
1751:     case MouseState::HZ_DRAG_LOOPEND:
1752:         display->sampleView[0].endLoop = sampleForXPixel(e.position.x);

1755:         break;

1779: void SampleWaveform::paint(juce::Graphics &g)
1780: {
1781:     if (!display->active)
1782:         return;
1783: 
1784:     auto r = getLocalBounds();
1785:     auto &v = display->sampleView[0];
1786:     auto samp = editor->sampleManager.getSample(v.sampleID);
1787:     if (!samp)
1788:     {
1789:         return;
1790:     }
1791: 
1792:     auto l = samp->getSampleLength();
1793:     auto fac = 1.0 * r.getWidth() / l;
1794: 
1795:     auto wfp = pathForSample();
1796:     {
1797:         juce::Graphics::ScopedSaveState gs(g);
1798: 
1799:         g.setColour(juce::Colour(0x30, 0x30, 0x40));
1800:         g.fillRect(r);
1801: 
1802:         g.setColour(juce::Colour(0xFF, 0x90, 0x00).withAlpha(0.2f));
1803:         g.fillPath(wfp);
1804:         g.setColour(juce::Colours::white.withAlpha(0.4f));
1805:         g.strokePath(wfp, juce::PathStrokeType(1.f));
1806:     }
1807: 
1808:     {
1809:         juce::Graphics::ScopedSaveState gs(g);
1810:         auto cr = r.withLeft(fac * v.startSample).withRight(fac * v.endSample);
1811:         g.reduceClipRegion(cr);
1812: 
1813:         g.setColour(juce::Colour(0x15, 0x15, 0x15));
1814:         g.fillRect(r);
1815: 
1816:         g.setColour(juce::Colour(0xFF, 0x90, 0x00));
1817:         g.fillPath(wfp);

114: void ProcessorPane::rebuildControlsFromDescription()
115: {
116:     resetControls();
117:     // TODO: Am I actually an off type? Then bail.
118: 
119:     if (!isEnabled())
120:     {
121:         setToggleDataSource(nullptr);
122:         repaint();
123:         return;
124:     }
125: 
126:     if (multiZone)
127:     {
128:         // it's a bit hacky to do this inline but I"m sure it will change
129:         setEnabled(true);
130:         getContentAreaComponent()->setEnabled(true);
131:         multiLabel = std::make_unique<sst::jucegui::components::Label>();
132:         multiLabel->setText("Multiple Types Selected");
133:         auto b = getContentAreaComponent()->getLocalBounds();
134:         multiLabel->setBounds(b.withTrimmedBottom(20));
135:         getContentAreaComponent()->addAndMakeVisible(*multiLabel);
136: 
137:         multiButton = std::make_unique<sst::jucegui::components::TextPushButton>();
138:         multiButton->setLabel("Copy " + multiName + " to All");
139:         multiButton->setBounds(b.withTop(b.getCentreY() + 5).withHeight(25).reduced(20, 0));
140:         multiButton->setOnCallback(
141:             [this]() { sendToSerialization(cmsg::CopyProcessorLeadToAll(index)); });
142:         getContentAreaComponent()->addAndMakeVisible(*multiButton);
143:         return;
144:     }
145: 
146:     setName(processorControlDescription.typeDisplayName);
147: 
148:     if (processorControlDescription.type == dsp::processor::proct_none)
149:     {
150:         setToggleDataSource(nullptr);
151:         repaint();
152:         return;
153:     }
154: 
155:     for (int i = 0; i < processorControlDescription.numFloatParams; ++i)
156:     {
157:         auto at = std::make_unique<attachment_t>(
158:             processorControlDescription.floatControlDescriptions[i],
159:             [this](const auto &at) { this->processorChangedFromGui(at); },
160:             processorView.floatParams[i]);
161: 
162:         floatAttachments[i] = std::move(at);
163:     }
164: 
165:     for (int i = 0; i < processorControlDescription.numIntParams; ++i)
166:     {
167:         auto at = std::make_unique<int_attachment_t>(
168:             processorControlDescription.intControlDescriptions[i],
169:             [this](const auto &at) { this->processorChangedFromGui(at); },
170:             processorView.intParams[i]);
171:         intAttachments[i] = std::move(at);
172:     }
173: 
174:     auto at = std::make_unique<attachment_t>(
175:         datamodel::pmd().asPercent().withName("Mix").withDefault(1.0),
176:         [this](const auto &at) { this->processorChangedFromGui(at); }, processorView.mix);
177:     mixAttachment = std::move(at);
178: 
179:     switch (processorControlDescription.type)
180:     {
181:     case dsp::processor::proct_SuperSVF:
182:         layoutControlsSuperSVF();
183:         break;
184:     case dsp::processor::proct_fx_waveshaper:
185:         layoutControlsWaveshaper();
186:         break;
187:     default:
188:         layoutControls();
189:         break;
190:     }
191: 
192:     setToggleDataSource(nullptr);
193:     bypassAttachment = std::make_unique<bool_attachment_t>(
194:         "Bypass",
195:         [this](const auto &at) {
196:             sendToSerialization(cmsg::SetSelectedProcessorStorage({index, processorView}));
197:         },
198:         processorView.isActive);
199:     setToggleDataSource(bypassAttachment.get());
200: 
201:     repaint();
202: }

139: float CubicInterpolate(float y0, float y1, float y2, float y3, float mu)
140: {
141:     float a0, a1, a2, a3, mu2;
142: 
143:     mu2 = mu * mu;
144:     a0 = y3 - y2 - y0 + y1;
145:     a1 = y0 - y1 - a0;
146:     a2 = y2 - y0;
147:     a3 = y1;
148: 
149:     return (a0 * mu * mu2 + a1 * mu2 + a2 * mu + a3);
150: }
151: 
152: float CosineInterpolate(float y1, float y2, float mu)
153: {
154:     float mu2;
155: 
156:     mu2 = (1.f - cos(mu * M_PI)) * 0.5;
157:     return (y1 * (1.f - mu2) + y2 * mu2);
158: }

160: float QuadSplineInterpolate(float y0, float y1, float y2, float y3, float mu, int odd)
161: {
162:     if (odd)
163:     {
164:         mu = 0.5f + mu * 0.5f;
165:         float f0 = mu * y1 + (1.f - mu) * y0;
166:         float f1 = mu * y2 + (1.f - mu) * y1;
167: 
168:         return (mu * f1 + (1.f - mu) * f0);
169:     }
170:     else
171:     {
172:         mu = mu * 0.5f;
173:         float f0 = mu * y2 + (1.f - mu) * y1;
174:         float f1 = mu * y3 + (1.f - mu) * y2;
175: 
176:         return (mu * f1 + (1.f - mu) * f0);
177:     }
178: }
179: 
180: float QuadraticBSpline(float y0, float y1, float y2, float mu)
181: {
182:     return 0.5f * (y2 * (mu * mu) + y1 * (-2 * mu * mu + 2 * mu + 1) + y0 * (mu * mu - 2 * mu + 1));
183: }
